subject: bench: --with-global-summary and --with-window flags in bench-arm.js
description:
Add flag-gated context injection to bench-arm.js.

When --with-global-summary is set on an ON-arm run:
- require('./context-inject-global-summary') and await getGlobalSummary()
- Prepend the paragraph to ON_PREAMBLE before the spec body

When --with-window is set on an ON-arm run:
- require('./context-inject-sliding-window') and await getWindowContext(5)
- Prepend a 'Recent completions:' block to ON_PREAMBLE before the spec body

Both flags are no-ops on OFF-arm runs (baseline unaffected). Flags combinable.

Only modify /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid/scripts/bench-arm.js.
Dry-run test: --dry-run shows augmented prompt; baseline arm prompt unchanged.

Depends on: context-inject-global-summary.js and context-inject-sliding-window.js existing.

summary: MERGE PENDING — orch/attempt/bench-context-inject-arm-flags: bench-arm.js updated with --with-global-summary and --with-window flags. Both flags are ON-arm-only (no-op for baseline OFF arm). --with-global-summary calls getGlobalSummary() → prepends LLM-compressed graph digest to prompt. --with-window calls getWindowContext(5) → prepends "Recent completions:" block. injectionPrefix is concatenated after on-arm preamble and before the spec body.
